records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Three unanswered outreaches (email:e2ce5069, email:270d38d8, email:dfe492b3) despite a held kickoff (calendar:c3f15f76); first project reached day 2 then no further activity, no invite sent, no tickets. Silence plus 8 days left suggests low unaided chance of hitting key milestone.

draft.subject: Quick help getting your Wrenfield workspace moving
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Following up on my last note — no reply needed if things are simply busy. You've got your first project created, which is the main thing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it would help, I'm glad to walk through the next step with you and your team on a 15-minute call this week — just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it. Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Best,
Chidi
